name: Enbridge Inc.
fundamentalsBasis: SEC EDGAR XBRL us-gaap facts of the annual 20-F or 40-F report with gaps filled from Yahoo fundamentals-timeseries, in the reporting currency; growth and margins in that currency, amounts and multiples over market cap in USD at Yahoo FX rates (balance sheet at the period-end rate, flows at the period average)

metrics.returnsBasis: Yahoo chart API: performance from unadjusted closes (D windows, 1W (5 daily candles) and 2W (10) count daily candles; 1M and 1Q take the candle closest to the same day 1 and 3 months earlier; WTD, MTD, QTD and YTD start at the last close before the current calendar week, month, quarter or year; 4M, 6M and 52W are calendar windows anchored on the last close on or before the target date), total return and CAGR from dividend- and split-adjusted closes

history.source: Yahoo Finance public chart API (adjusted close); monthly rows (month-end close, summed volume) with daily rows for the last 31 days
